msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia donna-islantilla-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a brown faux-fur cape poncho over a long brown satin skirt and suede boots from the reference, walking at a whitewashed street near the beach in Islantilla, Huelva, Spain, with bougainvillea and palm trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia donna-islantilla-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a dark green wool jacket embroidered with colourful flowers and leaves from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia donna-islantilla-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a pink and grey fringed knit poncho cape over a cream top and cream wide trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia donna-islantilla-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a black leather waistcoat over a cream top with a brown zebra-print satin maxi skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia donna-islantilla-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a long olive and pink floral tiered ruffled maxi dress with long sleeves from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
